auth_description: Log in to your account to continue.
auth_login_error_description: Incorrect email or password. Please try again.
auth_login_to_signup: Don't have an account? Sign up
auth_signup_description: Create a new account to get started.

auth_signup_to_login: Already have an account? Log in
component_role_switcher_role_user_descri: Standard features and content of the application
admin_proxies_servers_delete_description: This permanently removes the server and its agent token. Any remaining nodes must be deleted or moved first. This action cannot be undone.
admin_proxies_servers_delete_blocked: This server still has nodes; move or delete them first.
admin_proxies_servers_token_description: Copy this token now — it is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later. The agent uses it as a bearer token to pull this server's config (all of its inbounds) and report heartbeats.
admin_proxies_servers_token_docker_label: Or deploy the agent on the server host with a single Docker command:
admin_proxies_servers_form_description: Configure a proxy server host. The agent pulls one multi-inbound sing-box config covering every node on this server.
admin_proxies_nodes_delete_description: This permanently removes the node. The agent pulls it down on the next sync. This action cannot be undone.
admin_proxies_nodes_form_description: Configure an inbound on a server. The agent pulls the compiled sing-box config (all of the server's inbounds) and hot-reloads.
admin_proxies_nodes_form_no_server_descr: Create a server before adding nodes; each node belongs to exactly one server.
admin_proxies_nodes_field_address_helper: Leave blank to use the server's address.
admin_proxies_groups_delete_description: This permanently removes the group and its node memberships. Plans bound to this group lose access to its nodes. This action cannot be undone.
admin_plans_delete_description: This permanently removes the plan and its group bindings. This action cannot be undone.
admin_plans_delete_blocked: This plan has subscriptions and cannot be deleted
admin_users_ban_description: Bans the account and revokes its sessions. The user drops out of node configs when each agent next pulls.
admin_users_subs_delete_description: This permanently removes the subscription and its credentials. The user drops off the nodes on the next agent sync.
admin_users_subs_reset_description: New credentials take effect immediately; the old ones stop working when each node agent next pulls its config.
admin_users_subs_refresh_link_descriptio: The old link stops working immediately. Proxy credentials are not affected.
admin_users_subs_link_description: Import this URL in a Clash Meta client.
admin_users_assign_description: Creates a subscription with fresh credentials. Quota, duration and device limit are snapshotted from the plan.
admin_users_credentials_description: Embedded into node configs as the sing-box inbound user. UUID serves VLESS/VMess/TUIC; the password serves Trojan, Shadowsocks and the rest.
admin_users_search_placeholder: Search name, email or user ID
admin_users_select_all: Select all rows on this page
admin_users_export_truncated: Exported the first {count} users. Narrow the filters to export the rest.
admin_users_create_description: Creates an account. Without a password the user can only sign in through a magic link or a social provider.
admin_users_create_field_password_hint: At least 8 characters. Leave blank to create the account without a password.
admin_users_create_field_send_link_hint: Requires email delivery (RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_MAIL_FROM) to be configured.
admin_users_toast_created_subscription_f: The user was created, but assigning the plan failed. Assign it from the user page.
admin_users_edit_description: Changing the email does not sign the user out or re-verify it.
admin_users_password_description: Sets the password the user signs in with, creating one if they have none. Existing sessions stay signed in.
admin_users_toast_link_disabled_hint: Set RESEND_API_KEY and RESEND_MAIL_FROM to send sign-in links. Nothing was sent.
admin_users_impersonate_description: You will browse the app as this user for up to an hour. A banner lets you stop and return to your admin session.
admin_users_delete_description: This permanently deletes the user, their sessions and linked accounts, and all of their subscriptions with their credentials. This cannot be undone.
admin_users_bulk_ban_description: Bans the {count} selected users and revokes their sessions. Your own account is skipped.
admin_users_bulk_unban_description: Lifts the ban on the {count} selected users. Your own account is skipped.
admin_users_bulk_role_admin_description: Grants the admin role to the {count} selected users. Your own account is skipped.
admin_users_bulk_role_user_description: Sets the {count} selected users to the plain user role. Your own account is skipped.
admin_users_bulk_delete_description: This permanently deletes the {count} selected users together with all of their subscriptions and credentials. This cannot be undone. Your own account is skipped.
admin_users_sessions_revoke_description: The device is signed out immediately.
admin_users_sessions_revoke_all_descript: Every device signed in as this user is signed out immediately. Your own current session is kept.
admin_users_notes_placeholder: Add a private note about this user…
admin_users_notes_delete_description: The note is removed for all admins.
user_dashboard_subscriptions_no_active_d: Your subscriptions are currently inactive or expired. View all subscriptions to check their status.
user_dashboard_no_subscriptions_descript: Contact an administrator to get a subscription assigned to your account.
user_subscriptions_empty_description: Contact an administrator to get a subscription assigned to your account.
user_subscriptions_copy_disabled_help: Copy is unavailable because this subscription is inactive, expired, or out of traffic.
admin_mcp_connection_description: Use the MCP endpoint in compatible agents. OAuth metadata is published for automatic discovery.
admin_mcp_clients_empty: No OAuth clients have connected yet.
admin_mcp_audits_empty: No MCP tool calls have been recorded yet.
admin_mcp_load_error: Failed to load MCP administration data.
admin_certificates_create_description: Certificate creation is independent from servers; deployment capabilities determine DNS validation.
admin_certificates_letsencrypt_workers_n: Cloudflare Workers cannot use Let's Encrypt ACME. If this app is deployed on Workers, select ZeroSSL.
admin_certificates_zerossl_env_configure: ZeroSSL requires ACME_EAB_KID and ACME_EAB_HMAC_KEY in the deployment environment. Both variables are configured.
admin_certificates_zerossl_env_missing_n: ZeroSSL requires ACME_EAB_KID and ACME_EAB_HMAC_KEY in the deployment environment. They are not configured, so ZeroSSL cannot be used yet.
admin_certificates_zerossl_env_incomplet: ZeroSSL environment configuration is incomplete. Configure both ACME_EAB_KID and ACME_EAB_HMAC_KEY before using it.
admin_certificates_validation_domain: Enter one or more valid DNS names.
admin_certificates_validation_file_too_l: The selected PEM file exceeds the allowed size.
admin_proxies_nodes_field_certificate_ma: Selecting a certificate automatically installs it on this server and uses it for this node.
admin_proxies_nodes_tls_reality_help: Reality uses its own key exchange and cannot be combined with a managed certificate.
admin_certificates_dns_automatic_notice: Cloudflare DNS is configured for this deployment, so DNS-01 validation will run automatically.
admin_certificates_dns_manual_notice: Cloudflare DNS is not configured. After creation, copy the provided TXT records to your DNS provider and continue validation.
admin_certificates_dns_incomplete_notice: Cloudflare DNS environment configuration is incomplete. Automatic validation is disabled until both the API token and Zone ID are configured.
admin_certificates_dns_records_title: Add these DNS records at your DNS provider
admin_certificates_import_description: Choose a PEM full-chain and matching unencrypted private key. Domains and validity are read from the leaf certificate.
admin_certificates_private_key_file: Unencrypted private key PEM (up to 256 KiB)
admin_certificates_import_warning: Imported private keys are stored encrypted. Valid material activates immediately; future or expired material is staged as pending.
admin_certificates_replace_description: Upload a new full-chain and private key for this imported certificate. Valid material replaces the active version; other material is staged as pending.
admin_certificates_replace_warning: Replacing active material immediately reconfigures every bound server. Verify the new chain and key before confirming.
admin_certificates_pending_reason_not_ye: Reason: the certificate is not valid yet.
admin_certificates_pending_activation_co: Activate this certificate material despite its invalid validity window? It may be rejected by agents or cause TLS validation failures.
admin_certificates_pending_risk_warning: Activating pending material before the validity window is risky and may cause TLS errors.
admin_overview_error_description: Something went wrong while loading dashboard data. Please try again.
admin_overview_servers_description: Offline or failing agents, and servers with config changes awaiting apply.
admin_overview_servers_empty_description: Every enabled server is reporting in with no pending changes.
admin_overview_servers_none_description: Add a server to start deploying nodes.
admin_overview_quota_description: Active subscriptions that have used {percent}% or more of their traffic quota.
admin_overview_quota_empty: No subscriptions are near their quota.
admin_rules_note_client: Client rules go into Clash subscriptions ahead of the built-in defaults (LAN and CN direct, everything else through the proxy group).
admin_rules_note_server: Server rules are enforced on every proxy server and can only reject traffic. Lower positions are evaluated first.
admin_rules_error_description: Something went wrong while loading routing rules. Please try again.
admin_rules_delete_description: This permanently removes the rule. Subscriptions and servers stop applying it on their next refresh. This action cannot be undone.
admin_rules_form_description: Match traffic by domain or IP range and decide what to do with it.
admin_rules_field_values_hint: One value per line. Duplicates and blank lines are ignored.
admin_rules_field_scope_hint: Client rules go into Clash subscriptions. Server rules are enforced by every proxy server.
admin_rules_field_action_locked: Server rules can only reject traffic, because a server's only outbound is direct.
admin_rules_validation_domain: "{value}" must not contain spaces or commas
admin_rules_validation_cidr: "{value}" is not a valid IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR
admin_announcements_note: Published announcements appear on the user dashboard within their schedule window. Pinned announcements stay at the top and users cannot dismiss them.
admin_announcements_error_description: The announcement list could not be loaded. Try again.
admin_announcements_form_description: Announcements show at the top of the user dashboard.
admin_announcements_field_body_hint: Plain text. Line breaks are kept; HTML is not rendered.
admin_announcements_field_plans_hint: Shown to users with an active subscription on any selected plan.
admin_announcements_plans_empty: No plans yet. Create a plan first.
admin_announcements_field_pinned_hint: Pinned announcements stay first and users cannot dismiss them.
admin_announcements_field_schedule_hint: Leave both empty to show without a time limit.
admin_announcements_validation_title_len: Title must be 200 characters or fewer.
admin_announcements_validation_body_leng: Message must be 5000 characters or fewer.
admin_announcements_validation_window: End time must be after the start time.
admin_announcements_delete_description: Users will stop seeing this announcement. This cannot be undone.
admin_subscriptions_search_placeholder: Search user, email or subscription ID
admin_subscriptions_select_all: Select all rows on this page
admin_subscriptions_export_truncated: Exported the first {count} subscriptions. Narrow the filters to export the rest.
admin_subscriptions_bulk_extend_descript: Push back the expiry of the {count} selected subscriptions.
admin_subscriptions_bulk_extend_base_exp: Current expiry (or now, if already expired)
admin_subscriptions_bulk_reset_traffic_d: Set traffic used back to 0 for the {count} selected subscriptions.
admin_subscriptions_bulk_status_descript: Change the status of the {count} selected subscriptions. Re-activated subscriptions reach clients once the node agents have applied the change.
admin_subscriptions_bulk_plan_descriptio: Move the {count} selected subscriptions to another plan. Node access follows the new plan once the node agents have applied the change.

Otherwise each subscription keeps the quota and device limit it was sold with.
admin_subscriptions_bulk_delete_descript: This permanently removes the {count} selected subscriptions and their credentials. The users drop off the nodes on the next agent sync.
admin_audit_description: Everything admins did in the web UI, plus the tool calls MCP clients made on their behalf.
admin_audit_load_error: Could not load the audit log.
admin_audit_export_truncated: Exported the first {count} entries; narrow the filters to get the rest
admin_audit_purge_description: Permanently deletes admin audit entries older than {days} days. This cannot be undone. The purge itself is recorded in the log.
admin_audit_user_activity_empty: No admin activity on this user yet.
admin_audit_recent_description: The latest actions admins took in the web UI.
admin_traffic_description: Uplink and downlink usage reported by node agents. All times and buckets are in UTC.
admin_traffic_filter_user_search: Search user by name or email
admin_traffic_change_none: No traffic in the previous period
admin_traffic_chart_description: Uplink and downlink per bucket. Empty buckets are shown as zero.
admin_traffic_chart_aria_hour: Stacked bar chart of uplink and downlink traffic per hour
admin_traffic_chart_aria_day: Stacked bar chart of uplink and downlink traffic per day
admin_traffic_chart_hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to move between buckets, Home and End to jump to the first or last, and Escape to dismiss.
admin_traffic_breakdown_description: Who and what used the traffic in this range.
admin_traffic_empty: No traffic recorded for these filters.
admin_redeem_add_description: Generate more codes for this batch. They share the batch's plan and rules. The new codes are shown once.
admin_redeem_create_description: Generate one-time codes that grant a plan without payment. The plaintext codes are shown once after creation.
admin_redeem_field_mode_hint: New always creates a subscription. Extend renews the user's active subscription on the same plan (expiry pushed out, one more plan traffic allowance added) and creates one only if they have none.
admin_redeem_field_duration_hint: Leave empty to use the plan's duration.
admin_redeem_field_max_uses_fixed: Fixed at creation. The batch offers {total} uses in total.
admin_redeem_field_per_user_hint: How many codes from this batch one user may redeem.
admin_redeem_field_expires_hint: Codes stop working at this time. Leave empty for no expiry.
admin_redeem_field_disabled_hint: A disabled batch rejects all of its codes.
admin_redeem_validation_number: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}
admin_redeem_toast_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
admin_redeem_delete_description: "{name}" and all of its codes will be permanently deleted. This only works while nothing has been redeemed.
admin_redeem_detail_delete_hint: A batch with redemptions cannot be deleted; disable it instead.
admin_redeem_settings_description: Plan, mode and duration can be changed until the first code is redeemed.
admin_redeem_settings_locked: Plan, mode and duration are locked because codes from this batch have been redeemed.
admin_redeem_codes_description: Only the first characters of each code are kept. Full codes cannot be shown again.
admin_redeem_redemptions_description: Who redeemed a code from this batch.
admin_redeem_reveal_warning_title: This is the only time these codes are shown
admin_redeem_reveal_warning: Only a one-way hash of each code is stored, so they cannot be recovered later. Copy or download them now and keep them safe.
admin_redeem_reveal_toast_copy_error: Could not copy to the clipboard
user_redeem_description: Have a redeem code? Enter it to get a subscription.
user_redeem_error_invalid: This code is invalid or no longer available.
user_redeem_error_throttled: Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.
user_redeem_error_already_redeemed: You have already redeemed this code.
user_redeem_error_user_limit: You have reached the limit of codes you can redeem from this batch.
user_redeem_error_generic: Could not redeem the code. Please try again.
admin_plans_delete_blocked_trial: This plan is the new-user trial plan. Choose another trial plan in Settings first.
admin_settings_description: Registration, new-user trial, subscription output and site notices. Changes apply immediately.
admin_settings_reset_description: Every setting in this section goes back to its default and is saved immediately.
admin_settings_error_invalid_domain: One or more entries are not valid domains. Use example.com or *.example.com.
admin_settings_error_too_many_domains: At most 100 domains can be listed.
admin_settings_error_plan_required: Choose a plan to enable the trial.
admin_settings_error_plan_missing: That plan no longer exists. Choose another one.
admin_settings_error_trial_days_range: Enter a whole number of days between 1 and 3650, or leave it blank.
admin_settings_error_update_interval_ran: Enter a whole number of hours between 1 and 720.
admin_settings_error_test_interval_range: Enter a whole number of seconds between 10 and 86400.
admin_settings_error_url_invalid: Enter a valid http:// or https:// URL.
admin_settings_error_no_html: Plain text only. Remove the HTML tags.
admin_settings_error_title_invalid: Enter 1 to 64 characters, without quotes, slashes or line breaks.
admin_settings_registration_description: Who can create an account on their own. Admins can always add users from the Users page.
admin_settings_registration_mode_hint: When closed, nobody can create an account by email link, password or social sign-in. Existing accounts keep working.
admin_settings_registration_domains_hint: One per line. Leave empty to allow any domain. example.com matches only that domain; *.example.com matches its subdomains (list both for both). Case is ignored.
admin_settings_registration_verify: Require a verified email to sign in
admin_settings_registration_verify_hint: Accounts with an unverified email cannot sign in. Email-link and most social sign-ups are verified automatically; accounts you create with a password are not until you mark them verified.
admin_settings_trial_description: Give every newly self-registered user a subscription automatically. Users you create as an admin do not get one.
admin_settings_trial_enabled_hint: Each user receives it once, when their account is created.
admin_settings_trial_plan_hint: The plan cannot be deleted while it is selected here.
admin_settings_trial_duration_hint: Optional. Overrides the plan's own duration for trials only.
admin_settings_output_description: How the Clash subscription file is generated for clients. The defaults match what Blossom has always produced.
admin_settings_output_profile_title_hint: Used as the downloaded file name (.yaml is added); clients show it as the profile name.
admin_settings_output_update_interval_hi: How often clients are asked to refresh the subscription.
admin_settings_output_test_url_hint: Used by the Auto group to pick the fastest node.
admin_settings_output_test_interval_hint: How often the Auto group re-tests nodes.
admin_settings_output_mixed_port_hint: The local HTTP and SOCKS port the client listens on.
admin_settings_output_allow_lan_hint: Lets other devices on the user's network use their local proxy port.
admin_settings_output_rules_match: Everything else goes through the proxy (MATCH,PROXY). This final rule is always present. Custom routing rules still come first.
admin_settings_site_description: Help links and notices shown to signed-in users.
admin_settings_site_support_hint: Either, both or neither. Users see a Get help link in their sidebar.
admin_settings_site_notice_hint: Plain text, up to {max} characters. Shown as a banner on every signed-in page. Leave empty for none.
admin_settings_site_maintenance_hint: Shows a maintenance banner to users. Subscription links keep working.
admin_settings_status_description: Read-only. These are set through environment variables.
user_maintenance_description: Some features may be unavailable for a while. Your subscription link keeps working.
auth_signup_closed_description: New accounts can't be created right now. If you already have an account, log in instead.
auth_signup_domain_not_allowed_descripti: Accounts can only be created with certain email domains. Try another address.
auth_login_error_unverified: Verify your email address before signing in.
auth_redirect_error: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
landing_meta_description: Sign up, get a plan or redeem a code, then import your subscription link into a Clash Meta compatible client.
landing_hero_description: Create an account, get a plan or redeem a code, then copy your subscription link into a Clash Meta compatible client. Your traffic and quota are tracked on your dashboard.
landing_registration_closed: New sign-ups are currently closed. Sign in if you already have an account.
landing_feature_protocols_description: Servers run several proxy protocols through sing-box, giving you more ways to connect.
landing_feature_subscription_description: A single link works with Clash Meta compatible clients. Paste it once to import your profile.
landing_feature_traffic_description: See how much traffic you have used and what is left on your plan from your dashboard.
landing_feature_nodes_description: Connections are served from several servers and nodes.
landing_feature_redeem_description: Have a code? Redeem it in your account to activate or extend a plan.
landing_step_1_description: Sign up with your email address.
landing_step_2_title: Get a plan or redeem a code
landing_step_2_description: Ask an administrator for a plan, or redeem a code you already have.
landing_step_3_title: Copy your subscription link into your client
landing_step_3_description: Find the link on your subscriptions page and paste it into a Clash Meta compatible client.
welcome_error_description: We could not load your subscription details. Please try again.
welcome_description: Three quick steps and you're ready to connect.
welcome_step_access_description: You need an active plan to connect. Redeem a code below.
welcome_access_admin_note: No code? An administrator can also assign a plan to your account.
welcome_step_subscribe_description: Open your subscriptions page and copy the link for the plan you want to use.
welcome_step_client_description: Use a client that supports Clash Meta (mihomo) profiles, for example:
